# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Git-Aware Dev Journal — Remember Why You Wrote That Code</h2>

<p>A development journal that links notes to your git context. Every entry captures the commit, branch, 
and file position automatically. Stop losing the reasoning behind your code decisions.</p>

<h3>Core Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>Git-Linked Notes</b> — Entries auto-linked to commit hash, branch, and file position</li>
    <li><b>6 Entry Types</b> — Notes, Decisions, TODOs, Blockers, Insights, Questions</li>
    <li><b>Auto-Capture</b> — Conventional commits parsed into journal entries automatically</li>
    <li><b>Branch Narratives</b> — Auto-generated story of your work on each branch</li>
    <li><b>Timeline View</b> — Chronological view with search and filters</li>
    <li><b>Code Hover Context</b> — See why code was written by hovering over annotated lines</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features ($5/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Standup generator (Markdown/Slack format)</li>
    <li>PR/MR summary generator</li>
    <li>Unlimited notes (free: 50 per project)</li>
    <li>Cross-device sync</li>
    <li>Team sharing via .dev-journal/ directory</li>
    <li>Export (Markdown, JSON, CSV)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
    <li>Git repository</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="#">Documentation</a> |
    <a href="#">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="#">Contact Support</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Remember why you wrote that code, not just what it does.

**Short Description (200 chars):** Git-linked development journal. Auto-captures commits, links notes to code, generates standups and PR summaries. 6 entry types. Free core + Pro at $5/mo.
